description: This is a PHP source file defining the PimModuleController class within the OrangeHRM project. It handles the PIM (Personal Information Management) module's main logic, specifically redirecting to its default path.

classes.name: PimModuleController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling the PIM module; extends AbstractModuleController and implements a handle method to redirect to the PIM default path.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main entry point for this controller that retrieves the default PIM module path via a service and redirects the user to this path.
